entries.name: Docling
entries.description: Converts documents into structured content using configurable parsing, layout and OCR components.

license.notes: Individual OCR, layout and other model artifacts carry their own licenses.

deployment.notes: Select local components and pre-download required model artifacts; the whole pipeline is not one small model.

usage.needs_data: Source documents plus the chosen OCR/layout configuration.
usage.update_strategy: Pin parser and model versions; rerun a representative document regression set.

evaluation: Text/layout/table extraction accuracy per document family.
Peak memory and latency per page and per selected model pipeline.
limitations: Preserve originals, page references and extraction confidence.
PDF parsing is not invoice approval or legal interpretation.

evidence.notes: Document conversion features and separation of code/model licenses.

entries.name: SetFit
entries.description: Fine-tunes sentence-transformer-based classifiers for user-defined document, email or ticket categories.

model.measurement_scope: The chosen encoder and trained classification head determine deployment size.

deployment.notes: Local use after obtaining a compatible base encoder; target export must be checked independently.

usage.needs_data: Labelled examples for the actual routing taxonomy, including ambiguous and out-of-scope cases.
usage.update_strategy: Revalidate after taxonomy changes; retrain on reviewed examples.

evaluation: Macro F1 per category and per supported language.
Measure abstention and misrouting cost on organisation-separated examples.
limitations: Not a ready-made classifier for a particular company.
Encoder licensing and language support vary.

evidence.notes: Few-shot classification method, encoder-based training and Apache-2.0 code.

entries.name: LEGAL-BERT-Small
entries.description: English legal-domain encoder for adaptation to classification and information extraction, not legal advice.

model.measurement_scope: Publisher describes approximately one-third of BERT-base; exact artifact size not measured here.

deployment.notes: Local encoder inference; a downstream classifier or extraction head is an additional component.

usage.needs_data: English legal text; labelled examples for the desired clause or document task.
usage.update_strategy: Version task heads and evaluate changes by jurisdiction and document source.

evaluation: Task-specific F1 on source-separated legal documents.
Check jurisdiction, language and temporal generalisation before use.
limitations: Pretraining is not a ready-made contract reviewer.
Preserve source passages and require qualified review for consequential legal conclusions.

evidence.notes: Legal encoder purpose, English corpus and CC-BY-SA-4.0 model terms.

entries.name: spaCy en_core_web_sm
entries.description: CPU-oriented English NLP model bundle including generic entity recognition and linguistic annotations.

model.measurement_scope: Versioned multi-component trained pipeline; package and runtime size must be measured together.

deployment.notes: Pin the model package and compatible spaCy version together.

usage.needs_data: English text; annotated examples or rules for custom administrative fields.
usage.update_strategy: Evaluate entity coverage before updating model/runtime versions.

evaluation: Entity precision/recall by type and document source.
Test dates, organisation names and unseen formats on the actual corpus.
limitations: Generic entities are not an invoice or contract schema.
This English checkpoint does not establish French or Spanish support.

evidence.notes: English components, CPU-oriented use, MIT terms and version compatibility.

entries.name: GLiNER2.5 Small v1
entries.description: Compact English boundary-extraction checkpoint for entities, labels, structured records and relations.

model.measurement_scope: Publisher approximate FP32 weights and total parameter count; not peak process memory.

deployment.notes: Use AutoExtractor for this boundary checkpoint, not the legacy GLiNER2 span loader; CPU/CUDA/MPS paths are documented upstream.

usage.needs_data: English source text plus the requested schema; labelled examples for domain evaluation.
usage.update_strategy: Pin the boundary-compatible library and checkpoint; reassess after schema changes.

evaluation: Exact span/field F1, record completeness and false extraction rate.
Check truncation and cross-chunk relations on long documents.
limitations: Not a bank-card or MCU-class model merely because it is called Small.
Extracted amounts and dates require deterministic validation and source provenance.

evidence.notes: 74M boundary model, approximately 296 MB FP32, English and AutoExtractor loading.

entries.name: Presidio
entries.description: Hybrid NLP and pattern-based framework for detecting and masking sensitive information.

deployment.notes: Use local recognizers/NLP engines; an optional external integration changes the privacy boundary.

usage.needs_data: Text/images/records plus configured recognizers and language-specific NLP components.
usage.update_strategy: Maintain recognizers and test newly introduced sensitive formats.

evaluation: Recall and false positives by sensitive entity and language.
Test synthetic and reviewed real examples without exposing production secrets.
limitations: No guarantee of detecting all sensitive information.
Anonymization claims require a wider privacy assessment; masking alone is insufficient.

evidence.notes: Canonical repository, hybrid recognizers, supported data types and detection limitations.

limitations: The original repository is archived.
No universal business-category weights are provided.

evidence.notes: Supervised classification, quantization, MIT code and archival status.

entries.name: Splink

limitations: Probable matches should not silently merge consequential customer or supplier records.
Data normalization and blocking choices affect both recall and cost.

evidence.notes: Probabilistic linkage, SQL backend support and MIT license.
